text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: Daaaaah!!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: *pant, pant, pant*!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
...Ghh, T-Trainer!
What's my time... !?
The target time I've been striving for, all so that she can become an Umamusume capable of rivaling Orfevre.

"Enduring the hardcore training and honing her skills,
she has finally...!"

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
W-We did it!
I-I made it in time! Thank goodness...!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
"To be honest, I was so anxious about whether I could really do it—
but look at that...!
I can actually do it if I try...!"

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
"You worked hard.
You really gave it your all, Win Variation...!"

One day, while rejoicing over the achievement
and filled with growing anticipation for the future...

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
...Huh?
The one on screen over there, that's them, right?

Looking at the TV monitor
she was staring at—

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
“And coming from the outside is Orfevre!
She's steadily moving up!”
A broadcast of a graded race featuring Orfevre was playing on the screen.
"The race enters its final phase, and the pack hits the home stretch! Orfevre catches the leader from mid-pack, and—"

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: ...Haaah!!
She sprang forth like a coiled spring.

The gap between them closes in the blink of an eye.
Cutting through the wind and kicking up the turf, a furious pursuit.
Two more to pass, almost there—the moment I caught my breath—
The two leading Umamusume crossed the finish line.
Orfevre finished in 3rd place. ...However, the reaction from the crowd around her wasn't bad at all.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Her closing speed...
wasn't it faster than the girl who took first?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
Hey.
I heard the rumors, but... you really are impressive.
And after that—

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
—Why is that which should be here, gone?
Why does the sun not set? Why, here—

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: "...Tch, aah, aah... damn it all...!"

text_block_list.name: Interviewer
text_block_list.text:
Ah, there she is! Found her!
Um, Orfèvre-sa—
...Ah!

Orfevre was shown filled with so much fury
that the approaching interviewer couldn't help
but gasp for breath.

text_block_list.name: Interviewer
text_block_list.text: Ah... um, well...

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
――...What is it? Speak.
Surely it must be momentous enough to interrupt the wrath of a King.

text_block_list.name: Interviewer
text_block_list.text: O-Orph—

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: Speak!

text_block_list.name: Interviewer
text_block_list.text: Orfevre-san...! G-Great job out there...! Um... could we please get a quick word for the fans...!

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
...Heh,
haha, hahaha...!

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: —Very well. My head is clear now.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
...My people.
I shall avenge today's humiliation.
We will rewrite it all, and bring down the light.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
Every crown that exists upon the turf
was rightfully mine from the very start—

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
I am not foolish enough to be blind to the immense difficulty.
—Nor am I so ignorant as to not know the taste of redemption.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
However, even if it be a fantasy shrouded in dusk,
there is but one path We must forge—

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
"What lies before my eyes is—
nothing less than the glorious path of a King...!"

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
If you wish to see the path—
as always, bow down and worship...!

Orfevre's commanding gaze exerted an oppressive hold over the area.
Only her voice echoed through the vast underground paddock tunnel—

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: Never, ever forget these words.
Before I knew it, even the weekend shopping district had fallen completely silent.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: …………Orfe……

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: S-So electrifying~!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
It's a little scary, but...
Still, that power... what incredible charisma!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume C
text_block_list.text:
"Man, she fell a bit short this time, but still!
You just know she's gonna do something big someday!
Haah~~, she's sparkling so bright!"

Seeing her run out with an agonized expression,
I instinctively chased after her. I had a pretty good
idea of where she was headed.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: Damn it, dammit, dammiiiit...!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: What the heck... I was so happy about hitting my target time, and now I feel like an idiot for celebrating so hard...!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: ...The playing field... is far too different...

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
...Eh, ah! Trainer...!
I'm sorry, just now was—
choice_data_list: No, I'm sorry for tagging along on my own.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
...No, you're right.
I did dash out out of nowhere. I'm sorry.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: ...I just felt like, everything was totally different. And before I knew it, I was running.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
S-She only got 3rd place, yet she acts so haughty,
and on top of that, speaks of such grand dreams—

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
"I-It wouldn't have been surprising if they mocked her!
And yet, she silenced the whole place like that...!"

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
“It must be because...
it really was just that amazing.
And not just her late kick, either.”

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Words untainted by envy or jealousy.
Simply striving forward for the sake of a dream.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
She doesn't flatter, nor does she look back.
Arrogant, yet pure—

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Those words carried such weight and brilliance.
They were dazzling. Almost like—

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: ...Just like Dad.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: ...That's why—

Win Variation murmured weakly.
After a brief silence—

Though distorted with frustration,
the expression on her face as she looked up was dazzling.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: That's why, after all, I want to surpass them...!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
It might be impossible...
But someday, I swear I'm gonna beat her...!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
I want to be like that. I want to stand above them.
Someday, absolutely, without fail...!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: I'm gonna surpass it!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
...Phew! I feel so refreshed!
Sorry about that, you had to see an ugly side of me.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
The Classic campaign is starting soon—
this is no time to be feeling weak...!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
"I'm all good now!
I'm ready to give it my all again starting today!"

And after that, I discussed
future race rotations with Win Variation.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
She... Orfe-san will almost certainly pursue the Classic Triple Crown route.
So I believe she will run in the Satsuki Sho.
choice_data_list: Then I guess it'll be the Satsuki Sho.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
“...About that, actually...
There's something I'd like to ask your advice on.”

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
...Thinking about it realistically,
I don't think I'm quite there yet.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
"Of course, I haven't given up. To be honest,
I want to head for the Satsuki Sho with everything I've got—but..."

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
...Even if I went head-to-head right now,
I feel like I'd just lose without doing a thing.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Talking like this after getting so pumped up...
I'm such a scaredy-cat, huh?

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Still, if I'm gonna do it, I want to take it on properly.
Grown up, confident in myself, and giving it my all.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
So, how about we go for the Aoba Sho
instead of the Satsuki Sho next...?

The Aoba Sho is a GII race
known as a trial race for the Tokyo Yushun (Japanese Derby).

The rotation is fine. Honestly, I think she could
put up a good fight in the Satsuki Sho too, but...
I want to prioritize her motivation.
choice_data_list: Understood, let's go with the Aoba Sho.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Th-Thank you very much!
I'm sorry, but now that I've said it, I'll do my best...!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
"I will definitely grow stronger...!
Strong enough to hold my head high at the Japan Derby!"

—The next race was the Aoba Sho.
Thinking of a distant longing,
the days of racing through had begun.
